BiblicalUsage: Sitnah is an accusation, a written charge, and it appears once, in the reign of Ahasuerus, when men wrote an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem at the very beginning of his reign. The opposition to the rebuilding began with a letter before it ever became a sword.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe an accusation is often the first stone thrown, and God's people have always had to answer letters as well as armies.
